description: City Plan 2014 — Bicycle network overlay is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Plan 2014 is Brisbane City Council's plan for the future development of Brisbane. Brisbane City Plan 2014 is regularly updated with new or amended information. To stay informed about City Plan, including proposed amendments and to receive other Council planning and development updates, you can register your interest. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Property and Planning. Its keywords are arcgis, bicycle network, city plan, brisbane city council, planning, property and planning. The portal shows 3,508 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
